title: ZATCA Settings
subtitle: Connect each branch to your ZATCA account with a Fatoora OTP and monitor live production status from one owner workspace.
emptyBody: Add branches in the Branches page first

phase.notYet: This branch is not on Phase 2 yet
phase.upgradeHelp: Upgrade this branch to enable production ZATCA onboarding and invoice reporting.

guide.title: ZATCA Production Setup Guide
guide.intro: Use the official Fatoora portal to generate a branch OTP, then complete the live connection from Kubri.
guide.step1: Open the Fatoora portal and log in with your ZATCA account.
guide.step2: Go to the device or e-invoicing solution onboarding area.
guide.step3: Add a device or solution for this branch.
guide.step4: Choose the OTP/device count requested by the portal.
guide.step5: Copy the 6-digit OTP generated by ZATCA.
guide.step6: Paste the OTP into Kubri for the matching branch.
guide.step8: Wait while Kubri connects this branch to your ZATCA account.
guide.step9: When connected, keep issuing invoices from Kubri as usual.
guide.step10: Kubri will use the production connection for Phase 2 invoice reporting.

onboarding.ownerOnly: Production onboarding is restricted to the tenant owner.
onboarding.connectHelp: Connect this branch to your ZATCA account using a fresh OTP from the Fatoora portal.
onboarding.reconnectHelp: Re-onboarding may replace this branch's production credentials and can affect invoice submission. Continue only when you intentionally created a new OTP in FATOORA.
onboarding.capabilityHelp: Choose what this billing system will issue. For normal retail/POS invoices, usually choose Simplified/B2C only. If you issue tax invoices to VAT-registered businesses, choose Standard/B2B or Both.
onboarding.setupStep1: Open Fatoora and generate a 6-digit OTP for this branch device.
onboarding.setupStep2: Paste the OTP below. It connects this Kubri branch/device with your ZATCA account.
onboarding.setupStep3: Start production setup and wait for Kubri to confirm the connection.

disconnect.title: Remove local ZATCA connection
disconnect.help: This removes the production credentials from Kubri and stops this branch from submitting invoices through this connection. It may not remove or revoke the device from the FATOORA portal. Manage the device in FATOORA separately if required.
